title: Recap
description: Hours of footage as a short synopsis. Each object keeps a time label.
disabled: Recap is off. Add recap.enabled: true for a camera, then restart Frigate. Nothing else changes until you do.
deleteArchive: Archived recaps stay on the archive drive.
clickHint: Tap a time on the video to open that clip. While paused, every time on screen can be tapped.
openHistory: Open in Frigate review at this time
fromArchive: Playing the archived copy. Frigate no longer has this recording.
snapshotOnly: The recording has aged out. This is the archived snapshot.
clipMissing: This event is no longer available.
noEvents: No events for the selected types.
rangeInvalid: The end of the range has to be after the start.
rangeLong: That range is longer than this camera allows.
emptyPlayer: Pick a recap, or make one with the buttons above.
